UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$b='{{$FullBaseDir}}'; $f=Get-ChildItem -Path $b -Filter 'project-reclaimer-dedicated-v*.exe' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if(-not $f){ Write-Host 'No downloaded server executable found'; exit 1 }; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Destination (Join-Path $b 'project-reclaimer-dedicated.exe') -Force; Get-ChildItem -Path $b -Filter 'project-reclaimer-dedicated-v*.exe' | Remove-Item -Force; Write-Host ('Installed ' + $f.Name)"

-c "cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" || exit 1; f=$(ls -t project-reclaimer-dedicated-v*.exe 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n \"$f\" ] || { echo \"No downloaded server executable found\"; exit 1; }; cp -f \"$f\" project-reclaimer-dedicated.exe && rm -f project-reclaimer-dedicated-v*.exe && echo \"Installed $f\""

-c "export WINEPREFIX=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine\" WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all WINEDLLOVERRIDES=\"mscoree,mshtml=\"; if [ ! -f \"$WINEPREFIX/system.reg\" ]; then /usr/bin/xvfb-run -a /usr/bin/wineboot --init && /usr/bin/wine reg add 'HKCU\Software\Wine\Drivers' /v Audio /t REG_SZ /f >/dev/null && /usr/bin/wineserver --wait && echo 'Wine prefix created'; else echo \"Wine prefix already exists. Skipping\"; fi"
